method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

source_refs.locator: Printed p.76 (PDF physical p.81), section 2.1.1(4), agricultural vulnerability.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2018-12 reports: The communication identifies the Loess Plateau as China's most agriculturally vulnerable area; observed yield reductions affected one crop type on 90% and two types on 55% of its arable land.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Printed p.82 (PDF physical p.87), section 2.3.1(2), grasslands.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2018-12 reports: Warming and drying reduced northern-grassland forage yield and capacity, most in central-eastern Inner Mongolia and southeastern Gansu.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Printed pp.80-81, section 2.2.3 and Figure 3-13; basin water vulnerability.

evidence.scenario: Medium greenhouse-gas concentration scenario; comparison period 2021–2050 versus 1961–1990.
evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2018-12 reports: By mid-century, water vulnerability is projected to intensify in Haihe, Yellow, Huaihe and Song-Liao basins under combined climate change and rising demand.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Printed pp.6-7 (PDF physical pp.5-6), 2024 climate conditions.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025-06 reports: MEE reports 2024 national precipitation 9% above the 1991–2020 norm; Yangtze-Huaihe Meiyu rainfall exceeded normal by over 50%, and North China rainy-season precipitation by 83%.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Printed pp.10-11 (PDF physical pp.9-10), integrated disaster prevention.

geographies: provincial, county, township and village levels
evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025-06 reports: In 2024, China added 9,944 geological-hazard warning stations; six administrative levels logged 600,000 risk reports and helped move over 10,000 households and 30,000 people before danger.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Printed p.22 (PDF physical p.21), regional adaptation actions.

evidence.compact_statement: The ministry's 2024 progress report describes Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau coordination and research and reports 333.8 hectares of additional greening around Yellow River-area rivers, canals, lakes and reservoirs. These are government-reported activities, not independently evaluated resilience outcomes.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Printed pp.19 and 22 (PDF physical pp.18 and 21), city pilots and provincial adaptation plans.

evidence.compact_statement: The June 2025 ministry report records adaptation plans in 30 provinces and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps by February 2025, and a 2024 list of 39 climate-adaptive city pilots. Counts do not establish implementation quality or reduced losses.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025-01-17 reports: Local emergency departments reported 94.13 million person-times affected by disasters in 2024, 856 deaths or missing, and 3.645 million emergency relocations nationwide.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
